meta.name: hyperframes-cli
meta.description: Use the HyperFrames CLI development loop: init, add, catalog, capture, lint, check, snapshot, compare, grade-compare, preview, play, present, beats, keyframes, single or batch render, publish, cloud, cloudrun, feedback, lambda, doctor, browser, info, upgrade, skills, compositions, docs, benchmark, telemetry, transcribe, auth, tts, and remove-background. Also use when diagnosing build or render failures. validate, inspect, and layout are deprecated aliases; use check. Covers local, HeyGen-hosted cloud, AWS Lambda, and Google Cloud Run rendering.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你需要从命令行制作演示动画
copy.tagline_en: Create and render presentation animations from the command line.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to build presentations programmatically.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会知道如何通过 HyperFrames 命令行来制作视频：初始化项目、编辑时检查、预览、渲染成视频，还能在构建或渲染失败时帮忙排查。
howto.when: 当你说到 HyperFrames、要求执行相关命令（如 init、render），或抱怨构建/渲染失败时，它会接管操作。

say.text: 帮我用 HyperFrames 初始化一个新项目
say.note: 它会运行 init 并搭建项目骨架

say.text: 对这个项目跑一下检查
say.note: 它会运行 check（含 lint）并汇报问题

say.text: 用草稿质量渲染成视频
say.note: 它会执行 draft 渲染，方便快速迭代

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude knows how to use the HyperFrames CLI to build videos: scaffold projects, lint during editing, preview, render to video, and support local/cloud rendering. It also helps diagnose build or render failures.
howto.when_en: When you mention HyperFrames, ask for related commands (e.g., init, render), or report build/render failures, it takes over.

say_en.text: Help me initialize a new HyperFrames project.
say_en.note: It runs init and scaffolds the project.

say_en.text: Run a check on this project.
say_en.note: It runs check (including lint) and reports issues.

say_en.text: Render it as a draft-quality video.
say_en.note: It does a draft render for fast iteration.
